synopsis: B-777 Captain reported a burning odor while taxiing into the gate after starting the APU. Upon parking and shutdown maintenance discovered burned electrical components in the lower electrical compartment.
narrative: Upon taxi into the gate, and selection of the APU switch to On and Start, a burning odor was detected by both the First Officer and myself. The electric page showed all normal indications and the APU started normally. The Status page was referenced and it showed two Status messages: Main Battery Status and Main Battery Charger Status. The First Officer contacted station maintenance on taxi in and maintenance met the aircraft at the gate. Upon parking and the gate and deplaning the passengers a maintenance write up was accomplished and, maintenance accessed the compartment. They discovered soot and charring on the battery box and connector. Smoke was observed as well. The battery was disconnected and the airplane de-powered.

evidence.quote: Upon taxi into the gate, and selection of the APU switch to On and Start, a burning odor was detected by both the First Officer and myself.
